description: Turns a melody upside down, reflecting every note the same number of semitones the other side of a pivot note

inputs.text: The pitch the melody is reflected around, 1V per octave, one channel only
The melody to invert, 1V per octave, one note per polyphonic channel

outputs.text: The melody and its inversion together, 1V per octave, two channels for each channel of the melody: the original note first, then its inversion
The inverted melody, 1V per octave, one channel for each channel of the melody

notes: the inversion is chromatic, so the result leaves the key of the melody; quantise it afterwards for an inversion that stays in key
pitches are held between -10V and 10V before and after the reflection

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
